arguments.question: Does NVIDIA’s latest 10-Q or related SEC filing quantify any revenue, customer financing, receivable, guarantee, debt, or other exposure that would make the announced third-party AI-compute financing platforms measurably sensitive to interest rates over the next 21/63 sessions? Please provide issuer evidence only.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether the Fed’s 3.75%-4.00% policy stance can be treated as an NVDA-specific fundamental financing channel rather than only a general valuation/AI-customer-financing channel.
